description: This file implements a SQL store for managing groups, including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, and synchronization of group data, as well as handling group memberships, associated channels and teams, and related queries within the Mattermost server.

classes.name: SqlGroupStore
classes.description: Main class implementing group-related database operations, including CRUD, membership management, and syncable associations.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new group record in the database.

methods.name: CreateWithUserIds
methods.description: Creates a new group with associated user IDs, inserting group and membership data within a transaction.

methods.name: checkUsersExist
methods.description: Verifies that all specified user IDs exist and are not deleted.

methods.name: buildInsertGroupUsersQuery
methods.description: Builds an SQL query to insert multiple group-user membership records.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a group by its ID.

methods.name: GetByName
methods.description: Retrieves a group by its name with optional filtering.

methods.name: GetByNames
methods.description: Retrieves multiple groups by their names.

methods.name: GetByIDs
methods.description: Retrieves multiple groups by their IDs.

methods.name: GetByRemoteID
methods.description: Retrieves a group by its remote ID and source.

methods.name: GetAllBySource
methods.description: Retrieves all groups from a specific source.

methods.name: GetByUser
methods.description: Retrieves groups associated with a specific user.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing group's details.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Marks a group as deleted (soft delete).

methods.name: Restore
methods.description: Restores a previously deleted group.

methods.name: GetMember
methods.description: Retrieves a specific group member record.

methods.name: GetMemberUsers
methods.description: Retrieves users who are members of a specific group.

methods.name: GetMemberUsersPage
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of group members.

methods.name: GetMemberUsersSortedPage
methods.description: Retrieves a sorted, paginated list of group members with display options.

methods.name: GetNonMemberUsersPage
methods.description: Retrieves users not in the group, paginated.

methods.name: GetMemberCount
methods.description: Counts the number of members in a group.

methods.name: GetMemberCountWithRestrictions
methods.description: Counts members with view restrictions applied.

methods.name: GetMemberUsersInTeam
methods.description: Retrieves users in a group who are also in a specific team.

methods.name: GetMemberUsersNotInChannel
methods.description: Retrieves users in a group not in a specific channel.

methods.name: UpsertMember
methods.description: Adds or updates a group member record.

methods.name: DeleteMember
methods.description: Removes a user from a group.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteMembersByUser
methods.description: Permanently deletes all group memberships for a user.

methods.name: CreateGroupSyncable
methods.description: Creates a syncable association (team or channel) with a group.

methods.name: GetGroupSyncable
methods.description: Retrieves a specific group syncable association.

methods.name: getGroupSyncable
methods.description: Internal method to fetch a group syncable by ID and type.

methods.name: GetAllGroupSyncablesByGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves all syncables associated with a group.

methods.name: UpdateGroupSyncable
methods.description: Updates a group syncable association.

methods.name: DeleteGroupSyncable
methods.description: Deletes (soft delete) a group syncable association.

methods.name: TeamMembersToAdd
methods.description: Finds team members to add based on auto-add rules since a timestamp.

methods.name: ChannelMembersToAdd
methods.description: Finds channel members to add based on auto-add rules since a timestamp.

methods.name: TeamMembersToRemove
methods.description: Finds team members to remove based on constraints.

methods.name: CountGroupsByChannel
methods.description: Counts groups associated with a specific channel.

methods.name: GetGroupsByChannel
methods.description: Retrieves groups associated with a specific channel.

methods.name: GetGroupsByTeam
methods.description: Retrieves groups associated with a specific team.

methods.name: GetGroupsAssociatedToChannelsByTeam
methods.description: Retrieves channel associations for groups within a team.

methods.name: GetGroups
methods.description: Retrieves groups with filtering, pagination, and various options.

methods.name: teamMembersMinusGroupMembersQuery
methods.description: Builds query for users in a team minus those in specified groups.

methods.name: TeamMembersMinusGroupMembers
methods.description: Retrieves users in a team minus specified groups, paginated.

methods.name: CountTeamMembersMinusGroupMembers
methods.description: Counts users in a team minus specified groups.

methods.name: channelMembersMinusGroupMembersQuery
methods.description: Builds query for users in a channel minus those in specified groups.

methods.name: ChannelMembersMinusGroupMembers
methods.description: Retrieves users in a channel minus specified groups, paginated.

methods.name: CountChannelMembersMinusGroupMembers
methods.description: Counts users in a channel minus specified groups.

methods.name: AdminRoleGroupsForSyncableMember
methods.description: Finds admin groups for a user in a syncable (channel or team).

methods.name: PermittedSyncableAdmins
methods.description: Finds users with admin permissions for a syncable.

methods.name: GroupCount
methods.description: Counts total groups.

methods.name: GroupCountBySource
methods.description: Counts groups by source.

methods.name: GroupTeamCount
methods.description: Counts total group-team associations.

methods.name: GroupChannelCount
methods.description: Counts total group-channel associations.

methods.name: GroupMemberCount
methods.description: Counts total group members.

methods.name: DistinctGroupMemberCount
methods.description: Counts distinct group members.

methods.name: DistinctGroupMemberCountForSource
methods.description: Counts distinct group members for a source.

methods.name: GroupCountWithAllowReference
methods.description: Counts groups with allow reference enabled.

methods.name: countTable
methods.description: Helper to count records in a table.

methods.name: countTableWithSelectAndWhere
methods.description: Helper to count records with specific select and where conditions.

methods.name: UpsertMembers
methods.description: Bulk insert or update multiple group members.

methods.name: buildUpsertMembersQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL query for upserting group members.

methods.name: DeleteMembers
methods.description: Bulk delete (soft delete) multiple group members.

methods.name: buildDeleteMembersQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL query for deleting group members.
